verdict.rationale: Paddle documents built-in multi-currency support for both payments and payouts, so customers can pay in their local currency and the merchant is paid out in their own. It also offers localized pricing pages and payout reconciliation reports that itemize fees in both transaction and balance currencies, which gives some visibility into FX. The 'transparent FX handling' part of the story is only implied by those reports, so the coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: documentation of FX conversion rates, spread or markup and when conversion happens; any statement of how FX costs are disclosed to the merchant; independent or hands-on corroboration of local-currency charging and home-currency settlement.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Paddle has built-in support for multi-currency for both payments and payouts, letting customers purchase in their local currency and letting you get paid in yours.
Build pricing pages that show customers prices localized for their country and currency
Review itemized gross, taxes, Paddle, chargeback, and retained fees in both transaction and balance currencies
Payout reconciliation reports help you reconcile payouts to transactions and adjustments to understand how your payout amounts are calculated.
